jv: Ing candhi tuwa, raimu tak ukir
zh: 古老的石壁上，我刻下你的容颜
en: At the old temple, I carve your face
sung: Ing candhi tuwa, raimu tak ukir

jv: Watu lan wektu dadi seksi katresnan
zh: 石头与岁月，为这份爱作证
en: Stone and time bear witness to love
sung: Watu lan wektu dadi seksi katresnan

jv: Kowe liwat, mung sak kedhep mripat
zh: 你走过，只在一眨眼之间
en: You pass by, in one blink of an eye
sung: Kowe liwat, mung sak kedhep mripat

jv: Urip iki ora cukup kanggo nyandhing kowe
zh: 这一生，不够我伴你身边
en: This life is not enough to stand beside you
sung: Urip iki ora cukup kanggo nyandhing kowe

jv: Ing kali wengi, keroncong nangis lirih
zh: 夜的河上，琴声低低哭泣
en: On the night river, the keroncong softly weeps
sung: Ing kali wengi, keroncong nangis lirih

jv: Kapal budhal, aku mlayu menyang dermaga
zh: 船已起航，我奔向码头
en: The ship departs, I run to the quay
sung: Kapal budhal, aku mlayu menyang dermaga

jv: Tanganku nggayuh, segara wis misahake
zh: 我伸出手，大海已将我们隔开
en: My hand reaches out, the sea already parts us
sung: Tanganku nggayuh, segara wis misahake

jv: Urip iki maneh, aku kalah karo wektu
zh: 这一生，我又输给了时间
en: This life again, I lose to time
sung: Urip iki maneh, aku kalah karo wektu

jv: Yen iki dudu wektune
zh: 若此刻还不是时候
en: If this is not the time
sung: Yen iki dudu wektune

jv: Aku gelem ngenteni maneh
zh: 我愿意，再等一回
en: I will wait again
sung: Aku gelem ngenteni maneh

jv: Mbesuk yen urip maneh, goleki aku
zh: 来世若再相逢，请你把我寻找
en: Someday, when we live again, look for me
sung: Mbesuk yen urip maneh, goleki aku

jv: Ing antarane sewu rai, aku ngerti kowe
zh: 千万张面孔里，我一眼认出你
en: Among a thousand faces, I will know you
sung: Ing antarane sewu rai, aku ngerti kowe

jv: Sanajan lintang wis ganti panggonan
zh: 纵然星辰已换了位置
en: Even if the stars have changed their places
sung: Sanajan lintang wis ganti panggonan

jv: Tresnaku ora bakal lali dalan mulih
zh: 我的爱，不会忘记回家的路
en: My love will not forget the way home
sung: Tresnaku ora bakal lali dalan mulih

jv: Wis kaping telu aku lair
zh: 我已三度降生
en: Three times now I have been born
sung: Wis kaping telu aku lair

jv: Wis kaping telu aku kelangan
zh: 我已三度失去
en: Three times now I have lost
sung: Wis kaping telu aku kelangan

jv: Kayon ditancepake, lakon durung rampung
zh: 神山已立，这出戏还未落幕
en: The kayon is planted, the story is not over
sung: Kayon ditancepake, lakon durung rampung

jv: Saiki aku urip maneh, lan aku weruh kowe
zh: 如今我再次活着，我看见了你
en: Now I live again, and I see you
sung: Saiki aku urip maneh, lan aku weruh kowe

jv: Ing ngarepe candhi, mesem kaya biyen
zh: 在古老的庙前，笑得一如从前
en: Before the temple, smiling as you did
sung: Ing ngarepe candhi, mesem kaya biyen

jv: Sanajan kowe lali, atiku isih kelingan
zh: 纵然你已忘记，我的心还记得
en: Though you forget, my heart remembers
sung: Sanajan kowe lali, atiku isih kelingan

jv: Iki wektune, aja lunga maneh
zh: 就是此刻，不要再离开
en: This is the time, do not go away again
sung: Iki wektune, aja lunga maneh
